Advanced ATC

Desempenho de Comunicação Requerido 240

A globally standardized measure for communications capability, latency, and integrity in airspace—‘240’ indicates message transaction time ≤240 seconds (ICAO Doc 9869).

Quick answer: A globally standardized measure for communications capability, latency, and integrity in airspace—‘240’ indicates message transaction time ≤240 seconds (ICAO Doc 9869).

Why it matters
